catenaShort: Quoted verbatim from the Church Fathers venerated in the Orthodox Church — St John Chrysostom, St Jerome, St Augustine, St Hilary, St Leo, St Ambrose, St Cyril of Alexandria, St Bede and others. Each quotation above names its own Father and the homily or work it is drawn from.
catenaLong: The patristic commentary quoted throughout is drawn from the Church Fathers venerated in the Orthodox Church — chiefly St John Chrysostom, then St Jerome, St Augustine, St Hilary, St Leo, St Ambrose, St Cyril of Alexandria, St Bede, St Cassian, St Peter Chrysologus and St Cyprian — quoted verbatim, nothing paraphrased and nothing invented; each quotation names its own Father and the homily or work it comes from.
